review_candidates.title: Business Analytic Manager
review_candidates.description: Hello. We’re Haleon. A new world-leading consumer health company. Shaped by all who join us. Together, we’re improving everyday health for billions of people. By growing and innovating our global portfolio of category-leading brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – through a unique combination of deep human understanding and trusted science. Our CBIA (consumer business Insight and analytics) team sits at the centre of how we grow. If you want your analysis to change what a business actually does, this is a good place to do it. This is the analytics partner role for one of Haleon’s most important APAC markets: Japan. You’ll own the commercial performance story for Japan on what changed, why it changed, and what we should do about it. Where relevant, you may also support Korea and selected APAC initiatives, bringing market learning into broader regional discussions. You’ll frame the questions, pull together syndicated sales data, panel, eCommerce, media and internal commercial data, and land recommendations that help the Japan business make better decisions. Where your work can travel beyond Japan, you may help shape selected APAC-wide frameworks that other markets can adopt. Responsibilities: Own the commercial performance narrative for Japan, connecting category, brand, customer, channel and financial data into a clear view of what is changing and why. Identify growth drivers, performance gaps and emerging risks early, and size the commercial opportunity behind them. Lead concise, decision-oriented business performance reviews for Japan leadership, with input into regional discussions where relevant. Partner with Commercial and Finance to strengthen forecasts, annual plans and long-range assumptions with evidence-based scenarios. Lead advanced analytics across pricing, promotion, RGM, marketing mix, ROI, assortment and scenario modelling to guide investment decisions. Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analytical briefs, robust methodologies and actionable recommendations. Build reusable analytics frameworks and scalable approaches for Japan, with the opportunity to contribute to selected APAC-wide performance measurement, digital and eCommerce analytics initiatives. Optionally support Korea or broader APAC analytics priorities when there is a clear business need, capacity and relevance to the Japan agenda. Raise analytical quality by integrating multiple data sources, managing agencies and data partners, improving governance and sharing best practices. Basic Qualifications : We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals: 7+ years of experience in market analytics, business insights, commercial analytics or a related analytics role, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Business-level Japanese and English communication skills, with the ability to engage Japan stakeholders confidently in both written and verbal communication. Strong understanding of Japan market data and commercial performance sources, such as POS, retail audit, panel, eCommerce, media and internal financial or sales data. Proven ability to translate complex or ambiguous business questions into clear analysis, practical recommendations and measurable business impact. Strong analytical, numeracy and problem-solving skills, with rigorous attention to detail and comfort working across multiple data sources. Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders through clear storytelling, confident recommendations and concise presentation of insights. Preferred Qualification : If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: • Consumer healthcare, FMCG or another data-rich consumer industry. • Experience in a regional or global matrix organisation. • Experience managing external agencies, data providers and analytical budgets. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Haleon we embrace our diverse workforce by creating an inclusive environment that celebrates our unique perspectives, generates curiosity to create unmatched understanding of each other, and promotes fair and equitable outcomes for everyone. We’re striving to create a climate where we celebrate our diversity in all forms by treating each other with respect, listening to different viewpoints, supporting our communities, and creating a workplace where your authentic self belongs and thrives. We believe in an agile working culture for all our roles. If flexibility is important to you, we encourage you to explore with our hiring team what the opportunities are.

review_candidates.title: Brand Strategist
review_candidates.description: Cybersecurity doesn't have to be boring. At Surfshark, we take a bold approach to building a brand that makes people feel safe and in control online. Our creative team is where strategy meets storytelling — and we're looking for a Brand Strategist to be the ultimate translator: someone who takes what the business needs to say and turns it into something people actually care about. If you want to: Turn business goals into human stories. Translate objectives, product priorities, and research into clear, structured, inspiring briefs that define the real problem the creative team should solve. Make tech sound human. Be the person who always asks "Why should anyone care?" — and gets stakeholders nodding at the same message before a single pixel moves. Shape how launches land. Own the messaging and communication strategy: what we say, to whom, and why, across every phase of a launch. Build what lasts. Create messaging frameworks, strategic toolkits, and briefing processes the whole company can rely on and scale with. Get local. Go deeper on our key markets. Figure out what makes them tick, what to emphasize locally, and make sure our global big ideas actually work on the ground. Stay sharp. Work with performance and research teams to analyze what's working, and feed those learnings straight back into the strategy. And you can check off: A builder's mindset. You've built communication strategies and nailed briefs from scratch. You don't need a playbook to get moving. Translation skills. You have a sixth sense for taking complicated, technical products and making them clear enough that your friends would get it. A global perspective. You know how to talk to the world — adapting messaging across cultures and markets without losing the core brand. Comfort in the gray area. Ambiguity doesn't scare you. When a brief is messy, you ask the hard questions, define the problem, and point everyone in the right direction. A confident voice. You know how to push back constructively, pitch your ideas, and get people on board — even when you're not their boss. Bonus points if you: Know your way around digital-first, SaaS, or subscription-based products. Don't just love a great creative concept — you love the performance data that proves it worked. Have spent real time working shoulder-to-shoulder with creative or product teams. Use AI tools to speed up insight synthesis and messaging iteration. Here’s the deal: Growth and learning opportunities: time dedicated to learning, conferences, online learning platforms, and books for your professional development; Health and wellness: we want you to feel and be your best. That's why we offer various benefits, from online workouts and a physical coach to health insurance and regular mental health checks; Tools of your choice: choose the technical equipment and tools you need to do your best work; Community and celebrations: get ready for long-lasting traditions such as yearly workation, Friday get-togethers, various team buildings and company celebrations; Work-life balance: We encourage working in the office, with the possibility of up to two remote days per week. Plus, with our WFA policy, you can work from almost anywhere in the world; More days off: additional vacation days depending on your tenure; Premium Surfshark accounts: for you, your family, and friends; Gross salary: 3900-5000 Eur/month. Although it may vary depending on your skills and experience.

review_candidates.title: Trainer - Consultant
review_candidates.description: Vanguard Business Solutions is a Cairo-based corporate training and consultancy firm. We provide consulting and training solutions for Egyptian and regional companies across commercial, leadership, and business-skills areas, including sales, soft skills, and other business critical aspects. About this role — please read this section carefully. This is a hybrid role. Part of your week is training delivery. Part of your week is building your own client relationships from first contact onward. You are not being hired to wait for a sales team to bring you work; in this structure, that work is yours to generate, with the founder's direct support. If the commercial half of this role does not appeal to you, this is not the right position, and we would rather you know it from this paragraph than discover it in month three. If it does appeal to you, because you have thought that you could win training business better than the people currently selling it, this role was built for you. What you will be responsible for Delivering to professional adult audiences, from frontline teams through senior management, on client sites and remotely Understanding a client's business problem properly before any program is proposed. Owning your client relationships end to end, from first conversation through post-program follow-up. Building and maintaining your own pipeline of prospective clients. Preparing proposals and carrying them through to close Keeping client and pipeline records accurate and current Required qualifications. These are mandatory. Applications that do not meet all of them will not proceed... You have 2 to 5 years of experience designing and delivering corporate training or facilitation to adult professional audiences. School teaching or academic lecturing alone does not qualify. Full professional fluency in both English and Egyptian colloquial Arabic, with the ability to deliver training in either. You will be assessed in both. Demonstrated client-facing or commercial experience, account management, consulting, pre-sales, or direct sales. Genuine willingness to carry the business development half of this role. This will be assessed. Based in Greater Cairo and self-mobile to client sites across the city. Own a working laptop and smartphone suitable for professional use. Available for full-time employment, with no competing training practice or conflicting engagements. A confidentiality agreement is signed with the employment contract. Preferred qualifications. A recognized training credential train-the-trainer certification, or affiliation with a body such as (CIPD) or (ATD). Business-to-Business (B2B) sales experience with a record of closed deals. An existing network among Human Resources, Learning & Development (L&D), and line managers in Egyptian corporates or multinationals. Depth in at least two of our program areas, ideally including sales or customer service. Experience working under remote management, or within a distributed team. What we are looking for in the person. Facilitation presence — you can hold a room of skeptical senior professionals and handle a challenge without becoming defensive Consultative mindset — you diagnose before you prescribe, and you are comfortable telling a client that what they asked for is not what they need Commercial drive — you treat client development as a normal weekly discipline, and rejection does not slow you down Business acumen — you can discuss Return on Investment (ROI) with a Chief Executive, not only content with a Human Resources manager Self-direction — you plan your own week and communicate proactively Adaptability — an English boardroom in the morning, an Arabic training hall in the afternoon Coachability and integrity — you take feedback without ego, you never oversell what a program can achieve, and you treat client information as confidential. Our hiring process. A screening call, a live assessment of both delivery and client-facing skill, an interview with the founder, and references. We will explain each stage as you reach it. How to apply. Send your CV to hr@vanguardgroupmena.com with the subject line "Trainer-Consultant — [Your Name]", along with a short video (no more than 2 minutes) answering one question: describe a training program you delivered that produced a measurable result for the client, and tell us how you know it did.

Collaborating with Product, UX/UI, Backend, QA, DevOps, Data, Marketing, Logistics across functional teams to deliver customer-focused mobile solutions. Integrating Android applications with APIs, microservices, payment gateways, loyalty platforms, analytics tools, recommendation engines, and third-party services. Supporting mobile initiatives related to personalization, customer engagement, promotions, notifications, and digital commerce. Collaborating with DevOps teams to enhance CI/CD workflows, build automation, and application delivery processes. Utilize AI-powered development tools like ChatGPT, Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini Code Assist, Windsurf or similar to improve development efficiency and engineering productivity. Apply AI-assisted development practices, including Vibe Coding and Agentic Development, while maintaining proper engineering discipline. Recommend innovative solutions aligned with Boutiqaat's technology strategy.
